para.text: XYGRAPH has been constructed as a set of routines, and not as a component. This enables maximum flexibility but has the disadvantage that no multiple copies (instances) can be made.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:0px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:none;

text-align:left; text-indent:0px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:none;
para.text: So you can place multiple paintboxes on a form and draw a graph in each of them, this by itself works fine. However, if you want for example to perform ruler or zoom actions XYGRAPH will always refer to the last paintbox refreshed and the graph(s) in that. The same problem arises with copy or print actions.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:0px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:none;

para.text: The best way is to define a single paintbox and place all the graphs in that one. Ruler and zoom actions will be in the correct graph automatically. This is the preferred option (see

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:0px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:none;

para.text: However if you still want to work with different paintboxes you have to tell XYGRAPH in some way which paintbox it should refer to. A crude way would be to call a

text.style: font-family:'Times New Roman'; font-size:12pt; font-style:italic; color:#000000;

para.text: event each time, but this will not work with zooming.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:0px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:none;
para.text: Therefore a more elegant solution is offered by the commands
, that work equally well for 2D as for 3D graphs.
